description: Convert a MusicXML score into a fugue.score.v1 asset, answering as a local import_score does inline. Pass musicxml, the score's text (at most 256 KiB; not a path, URL or zipped .mxl). Returns the conversion summary and score. To play it, give each cell its own cell_sequencer: cells [score.cells[i]] inline, step_count steps_per_cell, root_note score.root_note, clocked once per rhythm_grid step. An answer past 64 KiB is refused. Nothing is stored.

musicxml.description: The score's MusicXML text (partwise), at most 256 KiB.

name: import_score
title: Import Score
